main_measure.name: mean of forecast/10 x (5-bar forward return minus coin's mean 5-bar return), before costs
main_measure.threshold: confirm: mean > 0 with t >= 2; reject: mean < 0 with t <= -2; at least 300 non-zero-forecast cases

decided_by: The mean is above 0 with t >= 2 on at least 300 non-zero-forecast cases (confirm rule).
reading: The mean and t are taken over all grid cases at positions 0, 5, 10, ... of each window with a full 5-bar forward return (zero-forecast cases contribute 0), the coin's mean 5-bar return is the mean of its grid returns over all its windows, and the 300-case minimum counts the non-zero-forecast cases.
